SFX: *Clunk* (Prize drop sound)

■Direction
Awkwardly.
Eeeek!

Ehehe, even though I invited you so out of the blue.
The complimentary pass expires today, so this is a huge help♪
No... I'm sorry for getting so carried away.

Here I go again, acting on pure impulse...
...Ah—

Yes! We are usually escorted straight in, so...
I really wanted to wait in line with eager anticipation!
That's an exclusive from this theme park...!

She smiled as she spoke, but something seemed to be weighing on her mind.
I see... Perhaps lightening the mood will make it easier for her to talk...?

However, with its current position... it might be better to aim after it's restocked.
Let's warm up on another machine until then!
My target is... the one she said was cute earlier...!

Kita-chan had an urgent matter come up and had to go home...
I was just thinking about going all by myself instead!

While out taking a walk around town on my day off, I spotted
Satono Diamond looking troubled over something...

Fufu, the fun has only just begun~!
Next is the arcade! Come, let us go!
Ah, you got it! Congratulations!
...! Wow! Are you sure I can have it?

Yes, crane games are my specialty!
I've played them often ever since I was little—

We repack the prizes into shopping bags.
With this much, the two of us will have to carry them back with both arms full...

Ah, um, don't worry, I'll manage on the way home!
I am an Umamusume after all, so I'm quite strong.

Fufufu...♪ See? Pretty good, right?
I can win plenty more~!

Satono Diamond gave a bashful, troubled smile.
I felt as though I got to see many different sides of her today—

—Ufufu! What a surprise!
My goodness♪ Where did you just come from?!

I was so excited I couldn't even sleep last night—Oh, look!
Uma-kun is over there! Let's get a photo with him!
I'll cherish it.
Yes! Trainer, you've got this!

I would wait while playing with the arcade machines in the building
until their work was finished.

Oh, Trainer!
What a wonderful coincidence meeting you here.
GRAAAUUUUGHHH~~~~~!!

We stood in line, chatting for about an hour as we waited.
When our turn finally arrived, the attraction was...

Yes! Watch closely, okay?♪
I'll win anything you want, Trainer!
It's nothing!
Would you like to go to an amusement park with me?
A state-of-the-art haunted house...! I want to see behind the scenes too!
U-Um... Never mind!

Oh, look!
They have exclusive amusement park merchandise. How cute...!
I know! I'll win the same one so we can matc—

Ah, is this a secret door...?! Over here!
Is that where the zombies wait backstage...? Let's go see!

Wow~! So this is how lively
an amusement park is when it's not reserved just for us!

Next is... Ah, look over there! What a huge line...!
I want to get in line! Let's go!

(Come to think of it, it was just like this during that 'Flower Planting Campaign.'
You're always indulging whatever I want to do...)

Whenever my parents visited our affiliate gaming company,
I used to tag along quite often...

Or rather, playing these was the real reason
I wanted to tag along...! Fufu♪

(Is this what my senpai meant?
Am I just taking advantage of Trainer's kindness...?)

Hurry, hurry! Trainer, come join me!
Say cheese...!

They've set up quite a few crane games here
that were produced by our group company.

Mmmh~~~! That was so much fun...!
Every single attraction was absolutely wonderful!

Ehehe, looks like we got quite a haul.
Shall we call a taxi for the way back?

Satono Diamond won all kinds of prizes
for me in the blink of an eye...!
You don't need to return the favor; I only won them because I wanted to give them to you.
